title: Data Policy

data_policy_sections.text: Welcome to MitoCube! These Terms of Use (hereinafter referred to as 'Terms') govern your use of the MitoCube application (hereinafter referred to as the 'App'). By accessing or using the App, you agree to be bound by these Terms. Please read them carefully before using the App. If you do not agree with these Terms, please do not use the App.

Login credentials must not be shared with third parties: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and must not share them with any third parties. The App does not support guest accounts, and any member accessing the App must be associated with the CRC 1218. If a researcher leaves the CRC 1218, the account is blocked and the principal investigator becomes the new project owner. In case, a PI leaves the CRC1218, the PI may decide if the data are transferred to another PI, deleted or transferred to the INF team (ownership).

sections: Data must not be shared with third parties: Users of MitoCube understand and agree that the data collected through the App shall not be shared with any third parties without explicit consent from the user.

Once a principal investigator signed, data recorded by the service group Z02 (proteomics) will be uploaded automatically by the INF team: Principal investigators acknowledge that upon signing up for the App, their (PI and associated group members) data recorded by the service group may be uploaded automatically to the App's servers for storage and analysis purposes. Before the data upload, the Principal Investigator is informed via email.

Publication of Data: It is not allowed to publish the complete or parts of the data (plots, a subset of the data) for a project that was not acquired under the guidance of the assigned principal investigator. Data might be shared with third parties (external collaborators) but require the written consent of the principal investigator.

sections: Data Handling by Service Group and INF Team Members: Members of the service group (proteomics, Z02 (Krüger)) and INF team are not allowed to share raw data to third parties. If requested to do so, they must contact the responsible principal investigator for further guidance and authorization in written form.

Data Ownership: Users retain ownership of the data they input into the App. However, by using the App, users grant MitoCube a non-exclusive license to use, store, and analyze their data for the intended purposes outlined in these Terms

Data Retention and Deletion: MitoCube will retain user data for the duration necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in these Terms. Users may request the deletion of their data by contacting the INF team.

data_policy_sections.text: Accuracy and Legality: Users are responsible for ensuring the accuracy, legality, and ethical use of the data they input or access through the App. Users must not upload or share any data that violates any laws or regulations or infringes upon the rights of others.

MitoCube complies with relevant data protection regulations, including but not limited to GDPR and CCPA, where applicable. By using the App, users acknowledge and agree to MitoCube's data handling practices in accordance with these regulations.

MitoCube reserves the right to update or modify these Terms at any time. Users will be notified of any changes to the Terms via email or through the App. Continued use of the App after the effective date of any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

Users acknowledge and agree that MitoCube shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the App, including but not limited to damages for loss of profits, data, or other intangible losses.

By using the MitoCube App, you agree to abide by these Terms of Use. If you have any questions or concerns regarding these Terms, please contact us at hendrik.nolte@age.mpg.de (Hendrik Nolte, Max Planck Institute for Biology of Ageing). These Terms are effective as of 01.03.2024 and may be amended or updated by MitoCube at any time without prior notice. It is your responsibility to review these Terms periodically for any changes.

summary_points: Data and login credentials must not be shared with third parties (anyone, anything that is not funded by the CRC 1218).
Sharing data with third parties requires written consent by the principal investigator (PI) (email, please send a copy to the INF team).

Principal investigators that agree to the terms of use acknowledge that the INF team is allowed to upload quality controlled data (by ZO2) to the web application. This means that all CRC1218 members can explore the data that also agreed to this Use of terms.
